summary: Lewis Hamilton faces a reckoning in Austin as Ferrari's Kimi Antonelli arrives one victory away from clinching the world championship following the Mercedes driver's costly strategic blunder in Singapore. McLaren's second-driver battle intensifies as the team fights to maximize points in both championships with their constructors' title still within reach. A maiden world championship for Antonelli would reshape the grid's hierarchy and mark a seismic shift in the sport's power structure heading into the season's final races.
